title: Move server Directory struct into mimi-protocol
description: mimid-server (bead mimid-1wgh.31) defines a local serde Directory struct for GET /.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory because mimi-protocol's directory types (mimid-1wgh.5.2) did not exist yet. When .5.2 lands, replace the local struct with mimi-protocol's type and keep the server's hand-written §5.1 JSON test as the oracle.
notes: 2026-11-02: queued after mimid-1wgh.6.73 (in progress): Directory::new is called in 14 mimid-server test files plus http.rs/main.rs, overlapping the hub tests .6.73 edits. Approach: server builds a mimi_protocol::Directory (Some for each routed endpoint) via a server-side fn (an inherent constructor on the foreign type is impossible), router takes mimi_protocol::Directory, call sites updated; directory.rs unit test (hand-written §5.1 JSON) stays the oracle.
